bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
out="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$out"' EXIT
{
 echo '## 2026-11-15 Live post-menu and Creator readback'
 echo "Request: req_20261115074400000000c098"
 echo "GayBBS.Status=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
 echo "GayBBS.Image=$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
 echo "GayBBS.MenuReady=$(docker logs --since 15m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' && echo YES || echo NOT_OBSERVED)"
 echo "GayBBS.PanelStates:"
 docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT state||':'||COUNT(*) FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' GROUP BY state ORDER BY state;" 2>/dev/null || echo DB_READ_FAILED
 echo "Creator.Status=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1)"
 echo "Creator.Image=$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1)"
 echo "Creator.Restarts=$(docker inspect -f '{{.RestartCount}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1)"
 echo "Creator.Ready=$(docker logs --since 15m gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 2>&1 | grep -q 'CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS' && echo YES || echo NOT_OBSERVED)"
 echo "Userbot.Active=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
 echo "Userbot.Enabled=$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
} > "$out"
gh issue comment 56 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file "$out" >/dev/null
echo READBACK_PUBLISHED=PASS
